text:
maria: FYI - customer report: structured output 'items' objects are missing after model swap to rdx-matrix-3.0. Parser throws "Unexpected token "{""

kevin: Can you paste the payload they got?

maria: Pasting their sanitized response below (they send via support form). They say older model returned an array of objects, new model returns array of strings that look JSON-encoded.

maria: ```json
["{\"id\":\"item_1\",\"value\":42}","{\"id\":\"item_2\",\"value\":17}"]
```

sam: who rolled rdx-matrix-3.0 to prod? @deploy-bot any deploy logs? :face_with_monocle:

deploy-bot: deploy completed: rdx-matrix-3.0 -> region: us-west-2 at 1945678200. rollout: 100%. trace_id=tr_0a9c

kevin: If the model is returning JSON-encoded strings instead of nested objects that suggests the structured-output decorator or the model's system prompt changed behavior (added extra quoting). Could be a tokenization/decoder change where quotes are escaped before output formatting.

maria: Customer repro steps (from their ticket):
1) POST /v1/generate with model=rdx-matrix-3.0, mode=structured_output
2) prompt: "List items with id and value as JSON array"
3) response body: 200 OK, but structured parser fails client-side

maria: Their full request (sanitized):
```http
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "rdx-matrix-3.0",
  "mode": "structured_output",
  "prompt": "give me items"
}
```

sam: Can we reproduce quickly with curl? I will try to call hosted endpoint and compare rdx-matrix-2.1 vs 3.0.

kevin: Also capture token-level streaming to see if quoting happens in runtime or post-processing. If the runtime escape layer or JSON-mode postprocessor got an extra stage, that would explain strings.

maria: Customer provides correlation ids: req_id=rc_77a3, trace_id=tr_0a9c. They say this started immediately after yesterday's model swap. They are high-usage; asking for rollback.

support-bot: Alert created: ticket #CS-4387 linked. Priority: P1 (customer-impact, parsing errors). Assigned to: support escalation.

sam: Quick reproduction result (my call at 1945679000):
- rdx-matrix-2.1 -> returns [{"id":"item_1","value":42}] (proper objects)
- rdx-matrix-3.0 -> returns ["{\"id\":\"item_1\",\"value\":42}"] (embedded JSON as string)

kevin: OK that's consistent. Next: gather model config diff. Could be a change to the assistant/system template that wraps examples with triple quotes or does json.dumps in generation script. I'll diff the onboarding prompt and output_formatter in the model adaptor. @sam can you capture raw token stream?

sam: Captured streaming tokens (excerpt):
```
[  "[", "\"{\\\"id\\\":\\\"item_1\\\",\\\"value\\\":42}\"", ",", "\"{\\\"id\\\":\\\"item_2\\\",\\\"value\\\":17}\"", "]" ]
```
This suggests tokens are already quoted before any postprocess.

maria: Customer wants ETA on rollback. Any blocker to rolling back to 2.1 in hosted?

deploy-bot: rollback possible. Can do blue/green swap to rdx-matrix-2.1 for customer region. Estimated time: 10-15m for canary -> 45m for full. Need signoff from eng-ml to avoid repeated churn.

kevin: I'll open a quick PR to revert the output_formatter tweak. If the rollback is faster for customer, do it first. Meanwhile I'll run unit tests that check structured_output unchanged.

maria: Action items:
- kevin: confirm model adaptor diff + PR (owner)
- sam: run canary against a sample customer request and post raw tokens (owner)
- maria: coordinate rollback if needed and update customer (owner)

kevin: Found change: previously we applied json.loads on internal examples; new change applied json.dumps on the final string when examples had nested objects. That mistakenly serializes objects into a string. Reverting now. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rdx-model-adaptor/pull/542

kevin: Tests: added regression test that asserts structured_output arrays contain objects not stringified JSON. Running CI.

maria: Customer notified: "We're investigating. If issue persists we'll rollback model for your region and keep you updated."

sam: CI passed on adaptor revert, canary test against sample customer succeeded, structured_output now returns objects.

deploy-bot: rollback completed: rdx-matrix-2.1 re-promoted -> us-west-2 at 1945679060. trace_id=tr_0a9c rollback=true

maria: Closing loop with customer, will mark ticket CS-4387 resolved after they confirm. Thanks everyone. :sparkles:

kevin: Follow-up: will add automated smoke test for structured_output on model swap pipeline to catch this in future.

maria: NOTE: add checklist item to model rollout runbook: verify structured_output schema hasn't become string-encoded.

support-bot: ticket #CS-4387 updated: status=resolved, resolution=rollback+fix, closed_at=1945679085
